name: nest
why: Mainstream TypeScript framework; decorator-heavy with many sibling modules.

ceilings.rationale: 2048 MB, sized to this corpus: ceilings are a function of the repository's own size, never of the CI runner hosting the test. The wall ceiling is deliberately loose - it exists to catch a hang, not to police throughput.

must_find_status: NOT YET CURATED. No recall assertion runs for this repository until duplicates here are hand-verified by diffing the reported ranges. An empty list asserts nothing - it must never be read as evidence that recall is good.

must_find_type2.why: The two shutdown lifecycle hooks are the same module written twice. Same imports, same callOperator over iterate/filter/map/toArray, same callXHook body: shift the module class host, spread controllers + providers + injectables + middlewares, await the non-transient batch then the transient batch, then call the module class instance behind an isDependencyTreeStatic guard. Only the hook symbols differ.
must_find_type2.verified: diff of before-app-shutdown.hook.ts against on-app-shutdown.hook.ts is a pure rename - BeforeApplicationShutdown/OnApplicationShutdown, hasBeforeApplicationShutdownHook/hasOnAppShutdownHook, callBeforeAppShutdownHook/callAppShutdownHook, beforeApplicationShutdown/onApplicationShutdown - plus explanatory comments, one Promise<void> vs Promise<any> return annotation, and the line wrapping those longer names force. No statement is added, removed or reordered.

must_find_type2.why: The built-in HTTP exception classes are one class body stamped out once per status code. Each extends HttpException, destructures extractDescriptionAndOptionsFrom(descriptionOrOptions), and calls super(HttpException.createBody(objectOrError, description!, HttpStatus.X), HttpStatus.X, httpExceptionOptions).
must_find_type2.verified: diff of bad-request.exception.ts against not-found.exception.ts changes only the class name, the HttpStatus member (BAD_REQUEST/NOT_FOUND), the default message literal ('Bad Request'/'Not Found') and the doc prose naming them. Every statement is identical in the same order. Sixteen further sibling files in the same directory repeat the same body.

must_find_type2_status: CURATED. Both entries were hand-verified by diffing the two files and confirming the only differences are renamed identifiers and literals - Type-2 by definition, and not byte-identical, so neither can reach the `identical` bucket. A miss on either is a false negative on proven ground truth. min_nodes values are floors, not pins, measured on this tree's release binary against the pinned sha with the gate's scan flags: the shutdown-hook module view rendered canonical_node_count 255 (floor 200 leaves single-measurement drift headroom and is 4.5x the 44-node sprawl cluster that spans the same pair plus three unrelated files); the exception-family view rendered 70 across its 17 stamped files (floor 50 leaves drift headroom on a genuinely small module while staying above the five-line boilerplate scale gh #439 documents at 31-39 nodes).
